children: CALGARY, AB, Sept. 8, 2026 /CNW/ -- Alvopetro Energy Ltd. (TSX-V: ALV) (OTCQX: ALVOF) is pleased to announce that we have entered into an earning agreement (the "Agreement") in the Mannville heavy oil fairway, adding 28 gross sections (14 net) of high-quality heavy oil lands to complement and expand on our existing Mannville position.

Under the Agreement, Alvopetro has agreed to drill five earning wells commencing in Q4 2026, at an estimated cost of C$8.5 million. The program will employ proven open-hole multilateral well designs along with single-leg horizontal wells using re-circulation strings to unlock new reservoirs across the portfolio.
Key Highlights
Adding 28 gross sections (14 net), in the Mannville heavy oil fairway, complementing the Company's existing Mannville position;
Partnered with an established operator (Courser Energy) with a demonstrated track record in the Mannville play fairway with a strong land position and an inventory of ready-to-drill opportunities;
Commencing a fully funded C$8.5 million, five-well program expected to commence in Q4 2026;

Payout structure reduces risk by accelerating return of capital to Alvopetro by earning a 75% working interest pre-payout of the earning wells and a 50% interest post-payout along with a 50% interest in all surrounding undeveloped land; and
A potential drilling inventory exceeding 75 gross locations.
President & CEO, Corey C. Ruttan commented:

"The Courser team has built an impressive land position from strong technical work. This new partnership provides exposure to an attractive inventory of ready-to-drill locations within the Mannville heavy oil fairway to complement and expand on our existing position. The program also gives us exposure to multiple well designs in attractive reservoirs creating added optionality across our wider Mannville portfolio."
